next.reason: 1985: the END PROGRAM program-name 'must conform to the rules for forming a user-defined word', whose rules are §1985:IV.4.2.2.1 'A COBOL word is a character-string of not more than 30 characters ... selected from the set of letters, digits, and the hyphen'. 2023: program-name-1 of §2023:10.7.2, identical to the PROGRAM-ID name (§2023:10.7.3 SR2), is a user-defined word under §2023:8.3.2.1 SR1 (no reserved word) and §2023:8.3.2.2 SR3 (at least one letter), but §2023:8.3.2.1 now reads 'not more than 63 characters' with 'basic letters, basic digits, extended letters, and the basic special characters hyphen and underscore'. END PROGRAM A_B, or a 31-63 character name, is refused by the 1985 rule and accepted by 2023: a widened range. The changed text is the 8.3.2.1 general paragraph, which has no catalog row (kb/Work PB479).
